question: ___________ refers to a method adopted by the Central Bank to persuade or convince the commercial banks to advance credit in the economic interest of the country.
solution:
The correct answer is__** Moral Suasion.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Moral suasion is a method adopted by the Central Bank to persuade or convince the commercial banks to advance credit in the economic interest of the country. 
 
• It is a non-quantitative method of credit control as it does not involve any direct changes in the interest rates or reserve requirements.
 
• The Central Bank uses its influence and credibility to persuade the commercial banks to follow certain guidelines or policies that are deemed necessary for the economic growth and stability of the country.
 
• Moral suasion can be effective in situations where the Central Bank has a good reputation and credibility among the commercial banks and the public.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Marginal Standing Facility (MSF) is a borrowing window for the banks to borrow funds from the Central Bank in case of emergency or shortage of liquidity.
 
 
• It is a quantitative method of credit control.
 
 
 
• Credit rationing is a method of credit control where the Central Bank restricts the availability of credit to certain sectors or borrowers to control inflation or prevent speculative activities.
 
• Margin requirements refer to the minimum amount of collateral or margin that a borrower has to maintain for a loan or investment.
